videos.title: Sounds of the 60s with Tony Blackburn
videos.description: Tony brings you two hours of music from the best decade ever, with hits from Chris Andrews, Shangri-Las and The Seekers. This week, the top three comes from 1965.

videos.title: Dermot O'Leary
videos.description: Hot off their 8th Number 1 album, Kasabian frontman Serge Pizzorno joins Dermot. Plus, History Hit's Dan Snow dials in from his latest Shackleton-inspired adventure.

videos.title: Romesh Ranganathan
videos.description: Actor Bill Hader (Superbad, Inside Out) joins Romesh live in the studio to chat about the new The Cat In the Hat movie.

videos.title: Ellie Taylor
videos.description: Spend Saturday lunchtime with Ellie. Whether you're out and about or chilling at home, Ellie is standing by to speak to you and hit shuffle on all your favourite music.

videos.title: Rylan on Saturday
videos.description: Comedy legend Ruby Wax joins Rylan to spill the beans on her brand new tour, Absolutely Famous, coming next year, and reveals her favourite films and TV shows for the RY Player.

videos.title: Sounds of the 80s with Gary Davies
videos.description: A weekly celebration of the greatest musical decade - 'If you were there, you'd know'... and if you weren't, pay attention.

videos.title: Sounds of the 90s with Fearne Cotton
videos.description: David Baddiel looks back at his 90s, from topping the charts with Three Lions, to selling out Wembley Arena to becoming the first 'rock star of comedy'.

videos.title: Dance Sounds of the 90s with Vernon Kay
videos.description: Get your custom 90s horoscope as Vernon selects songs to match every sign of the Zodiac.

videos.title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
videos.description: Dermot has a Britpop Weekender with Shed 7, Rialto, Suede, Sleeper, Oasis, Elastica & Lush.

videos.title: CMA Music Festival 2026
videos.description: 2/5. Country star Shelly Fairchild with live music and interviews from the CMA Music Festival 2026 in Nashville featuring Keith Urban, Cody Johnson, The Band Perry and Shaboozey.

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's Sounds of Soul
videos.description: Tony's back with more heartwarming soul music and gems from across the decades. Including new music from Bruno Mars and the Sunburst Band, plus classics from Diana Ross and more.

videos.title: Romesh Ranganathan: For the Love of Hip-Hop
videos.description: To celebrate the winter holidays, Romesh welcomes some of his guests back onto the show to play some festive hip-hop. There are tunes from Outkast, Smino and Sweet Tea.

videos.title: Dolly Parton's Good List
videos.description: Another chance to hear global music icon Dolly Parton talk to Claudia Winkleman about her life, career and loves, as seen through her memories of Christmas.

videos.title: Mariah Carey's Christmas Hour
videos.description: Mariah's personally curated playlist which includes Christmas classics old and new from the artists who have inspired her.

videos.title: Tracks of My Years
videos.description: Gary Barlow, Howard Donald and Mark Owen from Take That join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives.

videos.title: Good Morning Sunday
videos.description: The Reverend Kate Bottley and Jason Mohammad are joined by Scottish poet Donna Ashworth for her Reflections.

videos.title: Love Songs with Michael Ball
videos.description: Your true stories and favourite love songs with Michael... easy like Sunday morning.

videos.title: Paddy McGuinness
videos.description: Paddy's live from Salford every Sunday morning with The Weekest Link quiz, the Kitchen Tip-Line, Paddy's Timewarp and another BIG question.

videos.title: Elaine Paige on Sunday
videos.description: Dame Elaine is celebrating Guys and Dolls and the Wicked films. Plus your Pantomime Break A Leg messages, Pick of the Flicks and her Winter Warmer Double Bill.

videos.title: Sounds of the 70s with Shaun Keaveny
videos.description: Ocean Colour Scene frontman Simon Fowler reveals his essential 'My 70s' tracks.

videos.title: Pick of the Pops
videos.description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1981.

videos.title: Pick of the Pops
videos.description: Mark Goodier counts down the chart from this day in 1995.

videos.title: Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour
videos.description: Tony Blackburn spins his personal pick of the hits from across the decades. To listen on most smart speakers just 'ask BBC Sounds to play Tony Blackburn's Golden Hour'.

videos.title: CMA Awards 2026
videos.description: Darius Rucker with the 60th annual Country Music Association Awards, country's biggest night. With Ella Langley, Taylor Swift, Chris Stapleton and Brooks & Dunn among many others.

videos.title: Radio 2 Unwinds with Angela Griffin
videos.description: Angela Griffin marks Thanksgiving season with a nod to gratitude, and reasons to be thankful.

videos.title: Radio 2 Unwinds Mix with Angela Griffin
videos.description: Your soundtrack to a peaceful rest, featuring Sade, Stevie Wonder, Lionel Richie and more.

videos.title: Richie Anderson
videos.description: Richie Anderson is live from Salford with your Monday Motivation to kick-start a brand new week, plus Secret Star and This Week in Songs.

videos.title: Alternative Sounds of the 90s with Dermot O'Leary
videos.description: An hour of alternative 90s party hits from the likes of Suede, Echobelly and Jesus Jones.

videos.title: Jason Mohammad
videos.description: Welcome! It's Early Breakfast with Jason Mohammad sitting in, featuring the Rewinder. What's a challenge that you would be willing to take on.

videos.title: The Sara Cox Breakfast Show
videos.description: Glenn Close chats to Sara! Plus, we celebrate another listener in Signed, Sealed, Delivered.

videos.title: Vernon Kay
videos.description: Vernon speaks to Gary Barlow, Mark Owen and Howard Donald of Take That for Tracks Of My Years all this week on the show.

videos.title: Jeremy Vine
videos.description: Jeremy and guests discuss the news headlines and talk to the people making them.

videos.title: Trevor Nelson
videos.description: Trevor brings you some of the best music from across the decades to get you through the afternoon.

videos.title: Angela Scanlon
videos.description: The official end of the day is here! If you're on the way home, wrangling the kids or working out what to have for tea... Angela's got the soundtrack and wants to hear about your day.

videos.title: Jo Whiley's Shiny Happy Playlist
videos.description: Jo brings her Shiny Happy Playlist, 30 minutes of feelgood music from 7-7.30pm to soundtrack listeners' weekday evening.

videos.title: Jo Whiley
videos.description: Jo hand-picks her favourite new music from all genres of the musical spectrum.

videos.title: The Blues Show with Cerys Matthews
videos.description: UK blues singer, songwriter and guitarist Oli Mac, also known as Mississippi MacDonald, joins Cerys to chat about his career and to pick some of his favourite blues songs.

videos.title: The Good Groove with DJ Spoony
videos.description: Feelgood tunes to groove and soothe your soul. Dr Beat is also on hand to prescribe a perfect tune for a listener whose week hasn't got off to the best start.
